children: Brookfield will host its 2026 Investor Day in New York with Brookfield Asset Management presenting Sept. 17.
Brookfield Asset Management’s Investor Day runs 12:45–2:45 p.m. ET on Sept. 17; follows with Brookfield Corporation session 3:00–5:00 p.m. ET.
Live webcast and presentation materials available at brookfield.com/investorday and company investor sites.
Attendees should register at least 15 minutes before the event; replay will be posted shortly after.
Brookfield highlights its scale: more than $1 trillion in assets under management across core strategies.
